Input.Label.Title: Create New Element
Input.Label.Introduction: This dialog allows you to create the documentation for a local CodBi-Element. The element's name may be prefixed with a path that can be multi-part, separated by dots (e.g., path.to.my.new.element). It must, however, adhere to standard naming conventions for identifiers. Further no local elements with paths that are already assigned to a native CodBi element may be created .
Input.Label.Outro.Header: Share your local Elements - A Win for All!
Input.Label.Outro.GoodToGoLocal: It's great that you're creating your own elements locally! We encourage you to share them with the community, as this is the best way to strengthen our library and thus enable everyone to create high quality standardized forms in an even easier and even more efficient manner.
Input.Label.Outro.ShareViaIssues: If you want to share individual local CodBi elements, you can do so via GitHub by creating an issue. This is a great way to get feedback and make your work visible. To do this, export the element to be shared via its options in the tree view and pack the JSON file that was created that way along with the Type or JavaScript source code into a ZIP archive, which you can then attach to the issue.
Input.Label.Outro.StrongerLibrary.Detail: More variety and utility for everyone.
Input.Label.Outro.FasterDevelopment.Deta: Saves time as everyone can build on ready-made solutions.
Input.Label.Outro.Quality.Details: The community continuously improves shared elements.
Input.Label.Outro.Knowledge.Details: We all learn from each other.
Input.Label.Outro.ImportantWhenNaming: Important when it comes to naming:
Input.Label.Outro.NamingConvention: Please use existing categories, which you can look up here. If possible, please classify your elements into existing categories.
Input.Label.JoinUsOnGitHub: Join our user base on GitHub to share your local developments and support the community!

pm.desc.codbi.standard_configurations.sy: Server-side standard configuration that activates Matomo/Piwik analytics tracking for the form. It is triggered when the AI reports {"id":"Holistic.Matomo.Tracking","targets":[]} in _codbiApplicability.applied (e.g. when the user says "Matomo-Tracking aktivieren" without an explicit SiteID). Uses the Matomo_SiteID / Matomo_URL plugin configuration.

Server-side standard configuration that applies Cleave-based input formatting to date fields (datatype starting with "date"). The server activates it automatically based on the field datatypes present in the form.

Server-side standard configuration that applies Cleave-based input formatting to phone number fields (datatype="phone"). The server activates it automatically based on the field datatypes present in the form.

Server-side standard configuration that applies Cleave-based input formatting to German postal code fields (datatype="plzDE"). The server activates it automatically based on the field datatypes present in the form.
Server-side standard configuration that applies Cleave-based input formatting to time fields (datatype="time"). The server activates it automatically based on the field datatypes present in the form.
